# Lisbon Finals

Lisbon Finals is an independent, autonomous aircraft-spotting and local acoustic-observation station on a residential terrace below the Lisbon Airport (LPPT) approach corridor.

The project publishes local observations, not official airport totals, certified airport noise mapping, or regulatory decisions. Measurements describe one fixed observation point in Lisbon.

## Core pages

- Live station: https://www.lisbonfinals.com/
- Data and methodology: https://www.lisbonfinals.com/data.html
- Historical archive: https://www.lisbonfinals.com/archive.html
- Monthly noise reports: https://www.lisbonfinals.com/noise-report.html
- Captain's Log: https://www.lisbonfinals.com/log.html
- Project and hardware: https://www.lisbonfinals.com/about.html
- Finals Network: https://www.lisbonfinals.com/host-a-node.html

## Languages
